intro.en: Build layered sequence figures in R with ggplot2: compare multiple sequences, annotate a circular map, inspect HSP alignments and connect independent views.

multi-purpose.en: Compare sequence intervals, gene order and observed relationships.

circular-purpose.en: Draw intervals, sites and cuts on one sequence and label them with fixed or repelling placement.

dotplot-purpose.en: Inspect alignment intervals on query and subject axes.

fusion-purpose.en: Connect independent plots through explicit source intervals.

grammar.en: The multi-sequence module has four Coord types. Circular and Dotplot add two more; Fusion is the composition layer. Layers, mappings, scales, positions and themes retain their ggplot2 roles.

chord-caption.en: Compare four genome references with strand-aware gene arrows and ribbons coloured by reported alignment identity.

chord-alt.en: Four-genome Chord flagship with labelled genes and alignment ribbons

linear-title.en: Collinear · order, orientation and cross-row links

linear-caption.en: The same source intervals share a base-pair scale. The declared display orientation orders each strand along its reference.

linear-alt.en: Four-genome Collinear flagship with strand-separated genes and cross-row ribbons

circular-caption.en: The dense pETDuet-1 map shows features and primers inside the backbone, with labelled cut positions around the perimeter.

circular-alt.en: pETDuet-1 circular map with features, primers and cut-site labels

fusion-alt.en: Six panels connect genome comparisons to an enlarged nucleotide alignment

dotplot-caption.en: The original 32 HSPs use colour for reported identity and line width for reported alignment length.

fusion-caption.en: Three views of the same relationships lead into a source interval, an alignment window and a detail showing individual bases. Use Auto Magnify to derive a detail window, or use Manual Magnify to connect a prepared character view.

source-note.en: Figures share traceable inputs and plot definitions. See the source records and reproduction notes:

optional-deps.en: The first plot uses bundled tables and ggplot2. The figure reproduction script also uses dplyr.

quick-intro.en: Use bundled tables to draw sequence backbones, alignment ribbons and sequence names. No file download or alignment program is needed.

quick-note.en: Each observation layer receives its own data. The coordinate system can change without redefining the sequence reference.

output-intro.en: Preview and save at the same explicit dimensions so labels are arranged for the intended figure size.

radial-caption.en: The same observations project onto radial spokes, preserving the reference identities and source interval endpoints.

radial-alt.en: Radial flagship derived from the four-genome Chord example

sankey-title.en: Sankey · source intervals across two mirrored columns

sankey-caption.en: Each source reference has a query and subject copy. Colours retain the same identity scale as the other comparison views.

sankey-alt.en: Sankey flagship derived from the four-genome Collinear example

install-development.en: From the root of this checkout, install the development source.

development-status.en: This README describes the in-development v0.50.0 source. Install from this checkout to run its examples.
